title: Set up the emergency override passphrase
purpose: Sets up the emergency override (break-glass) passphrase of one PIM Manager environment: stores a check of it (a salted, slow PBKDF2-SHA256 hash, never the passphrase) in the environment's PIM database, where the Manager reads it at once; the Manager needs no Key Vault access.
whenToRun: Once per installation, before the emergency override is needed (Settings > Emergency access shows 'Not set up yet' and the two-line command with this installation's values until it has run), and again to change the passphrase. An installation set up before 3.1.26 kept the passphrase in a key vault: the update moves it by itself where it may read that secret; otherwise run this once with -VaultName and -MigrateFromKeyVault (the passphrase is not asked for and does not change).

runAs.name: Member of the installation's SQL admin group
runAs.why: Writes the setting EmergencyPassphraseVerifier in pim.Settings, reads it back and writes the audit event.

runAs.name: Reader
runAs.scope: the resource group of the Manager container app
runAs.why: Reads the Manager app to find its database (PIM_SqlServer / PIM_SqlDatabase) -- not needed when -SqlServerFqdn and -SqlDatabase are given.

runAs.name: Key Vault Secrets User
runAs.scope: only with -MigrateFromKeyVault: the secret PIM-EmergencyPasscode in the key vault an earlier version used
runAs.why: Reads the passphrase hash an earlier version stored there, once, to move it into the database.

changes.object: the setting EmergencyPassphraseVerifier: PBKDF2-SHA256 over the passphrase's SHA-256 hex, 600000 iterations, 16 random bytes of salt of its own -- never the passphrase, never its plain hash
changes.why: The Manager checks a typed passphrase against it (constant time; 5 wrong attempts lock activation for 15 minutes). It works at once, with no restart and no engine run. The clear passphrase is never stored, never on a command line, never logged.
changes.undo: Run the script again to set another passphrase. Without the setting, emergency override activation is refused.

changes.object: one audit event emergency.passphrase.set (the algorithm and iteration count; never the check itself)
changes.why: Every change of the passphrase is recorded.
changes.undo: Audit events are kept by design.

changes.object: the result file named by -OutFile (never the passphrase, its hash or the check)
changes.why: For a caller that reads the outcome.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: The resource group of the Manager container app.

parameters.name: ManagerApp
parameters.help: The Manager container app; its PIM_SqlServer / PIM_SqlDatabase name the database.

parameters.name: ContainerName
parameters.help: The Manager's container, when the app has more than one.

parameters.name: SqlDatabase
parameters.default: the Manager app's PIM_SqlDatabase, else PimPlatform

parameters.name: VaultName
parameters.help: Only with -MigrateFromKeyVault: the key vault an earlier version kept the passphrase in.

parameters.name: SecretName
parameters.help: Only with -MigrateFromKeyVault: the secret an earlier version used.

parameters.name: MigrateFromKeyVault
parameters.help: Move the passphrase an earlier version kept in -VaultName into the database, once. The passphrase is not asked for and does not change.

parameters.name: Passphrase
parameters.help: The passphrase as a SecureString (at least 12 characters). Omit it to be prompted twice. Never plain text.

parameters.name: UseSignedInAccount
parameters.help: Sign in as yourself in the browser (or use the Invardia Support session open in this window); asserted to be a user in -TenantId with -SubscriptionId visible. No command-line tool, no module. The recommended way.

parameters.name: AdminAppId
parameters.help: Automation: the admin application's client id (with -AdminCertThumbprint).

parameters.name: AdminCertThumbprint
parameters.help: Automation: the thumbprint of the admin application's certificate in the local machine store.

parameters.name: OutFile
parameters.help: Write the outcome as JSON to this file.

readsOnly: the Manager container app (its PIM_SqlServer / PIM_SqlDatabase), unless -SqlServerFqdn and -SqlDatabase are given
whether a check is already stored (to say STORE or REPLACE)
whatIf: Asks for no passphrase. Signs in, reads the Manager app and whether a check is already stored, and prints the change it would make: 'What if: would STORE (or REPLACE) the emergency passphrase check in the PIM database (pim.Settings EmergencyPassphraseVerifier ...)'. Nothing is written.
undo: Run the script again with another passphrase. Emergency override activation is refused while no check is stored.
